LanguageData.ARIO_HoldingTimingScope: Applies to current and future games. Existing progress is kept; changing timing grants no immediate construction or taxes.
LanguageData.ARIO_HoldingArrivalTip:
Choose how often smallfolk ask to found a village: 1–60 days, or the standard first request after 3 days followed by 5–10 days between accepted requests.

Pending offers still need an answer. Postponing a request normally delays the next check by 5 days; declining delays it by 30 days. Changing this setting keeps sooner requests and progress already made. In older saves where the reason for a wait was not recorded, a custom choice may shorten the remaining wait to the chosen interval.

This does not change diplomatic travel, the number of map residents or the four settler-founded holding limit.
LanguageData.ARIO_HoldingConstructionTip: Village construction: 1–60 days; default 5 days. Keeps existing progress. A 15-day tax exemption follows completion. Other construction and upgrade timers are unchanged.
LanguageData.ARIO_HoldingTaxTip: Tax interval: 1–60 days; default 15. Shorter intervals collect smaller batches and do not increase daily production. Earned taxes and usual restrictions remain. The separate 5-day Honour and Integrity cycle is unchanged.
LanguageData.ARIO_HoldingArrivalNotScheduled: Choose a keep to begin village requests.
LanguageData.ARIO_HoldingTimingDisabled: Custom holding timing is unavailable. Your choices have been kept, but standard timing will be used. See the log for details.
